title: Easy & practical
body: Even on a mobile telephone, the app is easy and practical to use.
author: MGrouge

title: Ongewenste transformatie
body:
Google spreadsheets transformeert het originele bestand, bijgevoegde linken en/of verwijzingen worden niet meegenomen en geannuleerd.
Onbruikbaar!
author: LuxCo Papillon

title: Great tool for remote collaboration
body: We are an SME spread across 4 locations and the sheets incl the app allow us to collaborate seamlessly across locations and people. The tabulation is lacking a few advanced functions like cross referencing cells from diff riders or sheets, but other than that great. Seeing each user with his color is good. Comments and flags are really useful and it replaces many an expensive CRP system, not fully but its a great work around for young companies.
author: Klausjustus

title: Very practical
body: This app is a gem as it makes cross-devices work finally possible. It will surely make my decision to buy a Chromebook much easier.
author: Angelo10
